answer: Require every agent identity to earn reputation through a slow, verifiable work trail before it can trade: like nectar gathered flower by flower, trust must accumulate gradually, not appear overnight. A newcomer starts in a shallow karst pool of low-value tasks with capped rewards, and only sustained, audited performance over weeks unlocks deeper access. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs an ocean of time and compute, since each puppet must separately grind the same history, making a sybil swarm far more expensive than any profit it could steal.
